quality_guards: The appropriate controls depend on the substance, quantity, process, releases, ventilation, ignition sources and workplace conditions.
DSEAR evidence is workplace- and process-specific and is not an exact parcel-level fire or explosion probability.
Radiation controls depend on the source, activity, time, distance, shielding, access arrangements and task.
Ionising-radiation evidence is source- and activity-specific and is not an exact parcel-level radiation probability.
Optical-radiation controls depend on wavelength, power, exposure duration, beam access, equipment condition and work practice.
Optical-radiation evidence is equipment- and exposure-specific and is not an exact parcel-level health probability.
Biological-agent controls depend on the organism, route of exposure, activity, concentration, containment and susceptible workers.
Biological-hazard evidence is organism- and activity-specific and is not an exact parcel-level infection probability.
Violence controls depend on the work activity, location, lone-working arrangements, public contact and incident history.
Workplace-violence evidence is activity- and organisation-specific and is not an exact parcel-level violence probability.
Controls depend on the young person's maturity, capability, health, task, environment, training and supervision.
Young-worker evidence is person-, task- and workplace-specific and is not an exact parcel-level injury probability.
Gas controls depend on appliance type, fuel, premises use, ventilation, flue condition, competence and maintenance history.
Gas-safety evidence is appliance- and premises-specific and is not an exact parcel-level gas-risk probability.
Controls depend on the pregnancy stage, individual health, task, posture, exposure, working hours and medical advice.
Pregnancy and new-mother evidence is worker- and task-specific and is not an exact parcel-level health probability.
Official-source context is not converted into an exact parcel-level probability.
